html:
SMTO-SKL-0175 — GitHub wouldn't start this automation with these settings

GUID: 3798dc6d-ee96-5fd2-bc17-2ff3d031c61a
Slug: github-workflow-input-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: github

What happened

  • GitHub refused to start this automation (a GitHub Actions workflow). The branch, the options you gave it, or the automation's setup didn't match what GitHub expects. Nothing was started.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. On github.com, open the Actions tab, select this automation, and look for a Run workflow button. If there isn't one, it can't be started on request; ask the person who maintains it. GitHub only allows starting automations that are set up to be run on request.
  2. Select Run workflow on GitHub to see which branch and options it asks for. Note the exact option names and allowed values. GitHub rejects the request if an option is missing, misspelled, or has a value it doesn't accept.
  3. Ask the Agent to start the automation again, giving the exact branch and options you noted. Nothing was started this time, so one corrected request is safe.

What success looks like

  • A new run of the automation appears in the Actions tab on github.com.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who maintains this automation. Ask them which options it expects.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • GitHub rejected the workflow_dispatch request with a 422 validation error: the workflow, ref or supplied inputs do not satisfy the workflow's declared workflow_dispatch trigger.

What this means

  • Workflow dispatch receives HTTP 422. This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.

Why this can happen

  • Workflow dispatch receives HTTP 422.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect workflow_dispatch declarations and requested ref; 422 alone does not prove a particular input is wrong.

How to fix it

  • Open the workflow file and confirm it declares an on: workflow_dispatch trigger, that the ref (branch or tag) exists, and that the inputs dictionary uses exactly the declared input names, types, choice values and required fields (max 25 inputs). Then send one corrected github.workflow_dispatch.
  • Verify the requested workflow/ref and its declared input names, types and required values before another dispatch.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The deliberate dispatch satisfies the exact workflow/ref and declared input constraints.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
